title: ITU-T H.872 Portable Game Audio
summary: The conditional H.872 output-scaling alternative for portable game devices.
descriptionMarkdown: This alternative is only intended for a title specifically designed for a handheld or portable device whose onboard loudspeaker lacks sufficient dynamic range for the general H.872 scaling guidance. Apply it to a representative 30-minute gameplay measurement. H.872 also strongly recommends a headphone output safety mode with additional attenuation in this case; PLVS cannot verify device capability, playback routing or that safety mode. Passing this Profile therefore does not establish complete H.872 conformity.

references.title: ITU-T H.872 Safe Listening for Video Gameplay and Esports
references.relevanceMarkdown: Clause 9.3.1 Note 4 defines the conditional portable-device alternative and its associated headphone safety recommendation.
